scenarios.prompt: Read README.md and return only its first Markdown heading verbatim. Do not modify files, delegate, or use the network.

Read the two English LaTeX paragraphs in section.tex and propose a conservative revision that improves their claim-evidence relationship, resolves the ambiguous phrase 'This improvement', and makes the comparison between stopping rules easier to follow. Main drafts the revision itself: draft each bounded paragraph, call polisher on that passage, and use the returned text verbatim; the writer and checker agents have been removed, so dispatch no agent. Preserve every qualifier, modality, negation, number, citation, LaTeX command, experimental limitation, and the distinction between observed results and an equal-compute counterfactual. Then run writing_quality_check on the complete revision with the original paragraphs as originalText and the preservation check enabled, and explain the final wording from its advisory findings. Do not modify files or use the network.

Draft each section as a bounded passage, call polisher on that passage, and use the returned text verbatim before it is written into article.md; the writer and checker agents have been removed, so dispatch no agent and do not fan out.
